data.description:
## Context / Problem
Twelve near-duplicate ticket verbs (`exists`/`format`, `check-ac`/`clarity-check`/`quality-check`, `tag`/`untag`, `get-file-impact`/`get-verify-commands`, `list-descendants`, `session-logs`) each own a route, a parser factory, a committed help artifact, and an exit-code row while their operation already exists on a golden-path verb or fits one flag. Operator decision (2026-09-06): hard cutover with no working aliases; removed spellings fail loudly with a replacement hint through the existing removed-name mechanism, which is kept and populated so future releases stay backward-compatible with it. ADR 0100 section 8 keeps JSON shapes and exit codes. The full mapping, evidence, and overlap ownership are in the epic's first comment (toadyish-sulfurous-ovenbird). Cites are on origin/main 2e81cb9767c1.

## Approach
(1) `src/rebar/_cli/_help_route.py`: replace `:49-55` with one dict `_REMOVED_SPELLINGS: dict[str, str]` (the 5 historical entries with their `docs/exit-codes.md:107-108` replacements plus the 12 above), keep `_REMOVED_SIMPLE_CLI_ALIASES = frozenset(_REMOVED_SPELLINGS)`; in `_emit_removed_alias_invalid_choice` write `hint: 'rebar <old>' was removed; use `<replacement>` instead` to stderr after argparse's error, returning its exit (2). (2) Registry: delete the 12 routes (`src/rebar/_cli/_registry.py:110-117,135-136,108-109,113,106` and `:200-280,388-390`), add `check` (`group="gates"`, `warn_cross_session=True`, `parser_factory="rebar._cli._parsers.core.gates:build_check"`, `handler="rebar._engine_support.gates:check_cli"`, `adapter="argv_tracker_root"`, `init="none"`), flip `resolve` to `argv_tracker_root`; drop `field_reads` and `descendants` from `_GROUP_TO_SET:52-65`. (3) Parser and handler edits per verb (the exact factory, handler, and line cites are in this ticket's first comment): `exists` deleted; `format` folded into `resolve --display[=MODE]`; `check-ac`/`clarity-check`/`quality-check` become one `check` route delegating to the unchanged `check_ac_cli`, `clarity_check_cli`, `quality_check_cli`; `tag`/`untag` deleted in favour of the existing `edit --add-tag/--remove-tag`; `get-file-impact`/`get-verify-commands` become `show --field`; `list-descendants` becomes `deps --descendants`; `session-logs` becomes `list --type=session_log --limit`. (4) Regenerate help and reference. (5) Gated docs: `docs/exit-codes.md` rows `:132,134,142,143,148,149,153,155,168,171,194` become rows for `check`, `resolve --display`, `deps --descendants`, `show --field`, `list --limit`; `docs/user-guide.md:30,32,239,240,251,266,297,306-308` (gated by `scripts/gen_cli_reference.py:206-227`); `scripts/gen_cli_reference.py` `MUTATION_VERBS` `tag`/`untag` (`:125-136`) and `EDITORIAL_PREAMBLE:47-49`. (6) Tests and scripts that CI runs: `scripts/probe_rebar.py:333-341,418-424,435,441,471-478,490,511-516`; `tests/unit/test_cli_registry_dispatch.py:168-196` rows; `tests/unit/test_cross_session_warn_routes.py:24-41` (`tag untag check-ac clarity-check` become `check`); `tests/unit/test_cli_registry.py:_CENSUS_SETS:29-47` (drop `_FIELD_READS`, `_DESCENDANTS`); rewrite the contract tests for the removed arms against the new spellings.

## Scope
`src/rebar/_cli/_help_route.py`, `src/rebar/_cli/_registry.py`, `src/rebar/_cli/_parsers/core/{lookups,gates,reads,writes}.py`, `src/rebar/_cli/_parsers/core/{field_reads,descendants}.py` (delete), `src/rebar/_engine_support/{lookups,gates,reads_cli,field_reads,descendants}.py`, `src/rebar/_commands/{__init__,_confirm}.py`, `src/rebar/_cli/help/*.txt`, `docs/cli-reference.md`, `docs/exit-codes.md`, `docs/user-guide.md`, `scripts/gen_cli_reference.py`, `scripts/probe_rebar.py`, `scripts/retarget_jira_project.py`, tests as named. Out of scope: the `store` group (next story), non-gated docs (docs story), `_intercepts()` at `_registry.py:413-514` (overlap epic), `src/rebar/_cli/_bridge_commands.py` (reconciler epic).

## Testing
For each old spelling: `rebar <old> ...` exits 2, stderr contains `invalid choice`, the old name, and `hint: ... use `rebar <new>``, and the handler is never called (extend `test_cli_registry_dispatch.py:459` parametrize from `_REMOVED_SPELLINGS`). `rebar check --help`, `rebar resolve --help`, `rebar show --help`, `rebar deps --help`, `rebar list --help` byte-equal the committed `help/*.txt` (`test_cli_registry_distribution.py:90`). `rebar check <id> --ac|--clarity|(default) --output json` bytes equal the pre-change `check-ac|clarity-check|quality-check --output json` goldens (existing contract tests re-targeted, exit codes 0/1/2 preserved per `docs/exit-codes.md`); `deps --descendants` bytes equal old `list-descendants`; `show --field=file_impact` equals `state["file_impact"]`; `list --type=session_log --limit=2` returns the 2 newest. `ruff check --select C901` on touched files at or under baseline; `python scripts/check_complexity_baseline.py --check`; both generators `--check`; `make verify`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `route_for(old) is None` for all 12 and `main([old])` exits 2 with the hint, verified by the parametrized dispatch test.
- [ ] `check`, `resolve --display`, `show --field`, `deps --descendants`, `list --limit` exist with committed help; `python scripts/gen_cli_help.py --check` and `python scripts/gen_cli_reference.py --check` pass.
- [ ] `--output json` bytes of every surviving op are unchanged (golden and contract tests green).
- [ ] The `docs/exit-codes.md` table matches `ROUTES` (`tests/interfaces/lifecycle/test_exit_codes.py:271`) and `scripts/probe_rebar.py` passes in `test.yml:199`.
- [ ] Library and MCP names untouched: `git diff --exit-code tests/unit/mcp_library_parity_manifest.json` is clean.
- [ ] `make verify` exits 0.
data.title: Merge twelve ticket verbs into check, resolve, show, deps, edit, and list; populate the removed-spelling hint registry
